question: Will Zcash (ZEC) reach $2,000 or more between October 15 and October 16, 2026?

calls.reasoning: ZEC ~$1,350-1,366 on Oct 6 2026; needs +47% (log 0.386) to print $2,000 high on CoinGecko during Oct 15-16 UTC. Realized daily vol ~6-7% => 10-day sigma ~0.19-0.22; reflection-principle touch probability by Oct 16 ~4-8%, reduced because the touch must occur inside the 2-day window (earlier touch-and-retreat resolves NO) => ~3-5%, nudged for fat tails/momentum (ZEC did +100% in a month recently). No scheduled catalyst before window (NU7 mainnet decision Oct 20, activation Nov 5; FOMC Oct 27-28); ETF had first outflow week. Polymarket 'ZEC $2000 by Dec 31 2026' at 0.39 (~$50k vol) is a near-miss contract (12x longer horizon, any-time touch), consistent with a low short-window probability. No matching Kalshi/Manifold market found.
